title: GDP Growth Rate and High-Quality Sector Share (2019-2028)
executive_question: How has China's GDP growth evolved and what is the projected share of high-quality sectors?
required_metrics: High-quality sector share of GDP (%): 35, 36, 38, 40, 42, 44, 46, 48, 50, 52 (estimated from NBS and 14th FYP targets)
comparison_set: GDP growth rate vs. high-quality sector share over time
preferred_sources: National Bureau of Statistics of China
search_queries: China GDP growth rate 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 IMF
China high-tech industry value added share of GDP 2023
14th Five-Year Plan target for strategic emerging industries share of GDP
data_quality_rule: Use IMF data for GDP growth; for sector share, use NBS official data for historical years and 14th FYP targets for projections. Mark projected values as estimates.
narrative_role: Establishes the macroeconomic backdrop and the increasing importance of high-quality sectors.
pre_exhibit_context: China's transition from quantitative to high-quality growth is reshaping the economy. This chart shows the trend in GDP growth and the rising share of priority sectors.
post_exhibit_takeaway: High-quality sectors are growing faster than the overall economy, indicating where foreign firms should focus.

title: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Inflows by Sector (2019-2023)
executive_question: Which sectors are attracting the most foreign investment in China?
required_metrics: FDI inflows by sector (USD billions): Manufacturing (high-tech), Services (IT, finance), R&D, Green energy, Healthcare
search_queries: China FDI inflows by sector 2023 MOFCOM
high-tech manufacturing FDI China 2022
foreign investment in China green energy 2021
data_quality_rule: Use official MOFCOM data; if sector breakdown not available, use UNCTAD estimates. Cross-check with NBS.
narrative_role: Shows where foreign capital is flowing, indicating sector attractiveness and policy openness.
pre_exhibit_context: FDI trends reveal which high-quality growth sectors are most accessible to foreign firms.
post_exhibit_takeaway: High-tech manufacturing and services are top FDI recipients, but some sectors remain restricted.

title: Domestic vs Foreign Market Share in Key High-Tech Sectors (2023)
executive_question: How do foreign firms compare to domestic champions in market share?
required_metrics: Sector: AI software, EVs, Semiconductors, Green energy, Biotech
comparison_set: Domestic vs foreign market share by sector
preferred_sources: China Association of Automobile Manufacturers (CAAM) EV sales data
search_queries: China AI software market share foreign vs domestic 2023
China EV market share foreign brands 2023
China semiconductor market share foreign companies 2023
data_quality_rule: Use industry reports from IDC, CAAM, IC Insights. If exact figures unavailable, use ranges and note as estimates.
narrative_role: Highlights competitive dynamics and the need for localization or partnerships.
pre_exhibit_context: Domestic firms are gaining ground in priority sectors; this chart quantifies the gap.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Foreign firms have strong positions in some sectors but are losing share in others, especially where government support is strong.

title: Consumer Spending on Premium and Green Products (2019-2028)
executive_question: How is consumer spending shifting towards premium and sustainable products?
comparison_set: Premium vs green product spending over time
preferred_sources: National Bureau of Statistics retail sales data
search_queries: China premium goods market size 2023 Euromonitor
China green consumption market size 2024
China middle class spending on sustainable products 2022
data_quality_rule: Use Euromonitor or McKinsey data for historical; for projections, use CAGR from recent years or IMF consumption growth forecasts. Mark projected values as estimates.
narrative_role: Demonstrates demand trends that favor foreign brands with premium positioning.
pre_exhibit_context: Rising middle class and environmental awareness are driving demand for premium and green products.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Premium and green segments are growing rapidly, offering opportunities for foreign firms with strong brand equity.

title: R&D Spending and Patent Filings: Foreign vs Domestic (2019-2023)
executive_question: How does R&D investment correlate with innovation output for foreign vs domestic firms?
required_metrics: Entity: Foreign firms in China, Domestic firms
Unit: USD billions for R&D, thousands for patents
comparison_set: Foreign vs domestic firms: R&D spending vs patent output
preferred_sources: National Bureau of Statistics R&D expenditure data
search_queries: China R&D spending by ownership 2023 NBS
China patent filings foreign vs domestic 2022 CNIPA
foreign invested enterprises R&D expenditure China 2021
data_quality_rule: Use NBS for R&D spending and CNIPA for patents. If foreign firm data not separately reported, use estimates from MOFCOM or industry reports.
narrative_role: Shows the innovation ecosystem and the importance of local R&D for competitiveness.
pre_exhibit_context: China's innovation drive is led by domestic firms, but foreign firms with local R&D can compete.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Domestic firms dominate R&D spending and patents, but foreign firms with significant local R&D achieve higher patent efficiency.

title: Timeline of Key Policy Milestones for High-Quality Growth (2015-2025)
executive_question: What are the key policy events shaping the high-quality growth transition?
required_metrics: Event: Made in China 2025 launched, Negative list revised, Dual circulation announced, 14th FYP released, Carbon neutrality target, etc.
Category: Industrial policy, Trade policy, Investment regulation, Environmental policy
comparison_set: Policy events over time by category
search_queries: China Made in China 2025 timeline
China foreign investment negative list revisions 2018 2020 2022
China dual circulation strategy announcement 2020
data_quality_rule: Use official government announcements and credible news sources (e.g., Xinhua, Caixin). Ensure dates are accurate.
narrative_role: Provides chronological context for regulatory changes affecting foreign firms.
pre_exhibit_context: China's policy framework has evolved rapidly; understanding the timeline helps anticipate future changes.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Policy milestones show a clear trajectory towards prioritizing tech, green, and health sectors while tightening foreign access in some areas.

title: Supply Chain Relocation: FDI Outflows from China and Inflows to Alternatives (2019-2023)
executive_question: Are foreign firms diversifying supply chains away from China?
required_metrics: FDI inflows to alternative destinations (Vietnam, India, Mexico) (USD billions): 5, 6, 8, 10, 12
comparison_set: FDI outflows from China vs inflows to alternatives
search_queries: China outward FDI 2023 UNCTAD
Vietnam FDI inflows 2022 manufacturing
Mexico FDI inflows 2023 from China
data_quality_rule: Use UNCTAD for cross-country comparability. For China outflows, use MOFCOM data. Mark estimates if data not directly comparable.
narrative_role: Quantifies the trend of supply chain relocation and its impact on China's role as an export hub.
pre_exhibit_context: Geopolitical tensions and cost pressures are prompting some firms to move production; this chart shows the data.
post_exhibit_takeaway: FDI outflows from China have increased, but high-tech sectors still attract significant inflows, indicating a nuanced picture.
